# EdrawMax

> EdrawMax is a comprehensive, AI-powered diagramming platform offering 210+ diagram types with free tools for flowcharts, mind maps, Gantt charts, organizational charts, and technical diagrams.

EdrawMax by Wondershare provides both desktop and online diagramming solutions with drag-and-drop editors, AI automation, collaborative features, and extensive template libraries. The platform supports multiple export formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, SVG) and integrates with popular applications like Word, PowerPoint, and cloud services.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered diagram generation
- Flowchart maker
- Mind map creator
- Gantt chart planning
- Organizational chart builder
- UML diagrams
- ER diagrams
- Network diagrams
- Floor plan design
- P&ID diagrams
- Concept mapping
- Drag-and-drop editor
- Collaboration features
- Template library
- Visio alternative
